pr_title: GameEngine: connect generic Graph and UI authoring adapters
pr_body:
## Summary

ADR 0121 follow-up after #69. Connect the shared authoring services to Editor, CLI, and MCP without introducing adapter-owned authoring semantics.

This follow-up commit fixes Windows Validation findings on the parity tests and synchronizes Cargo.lock for the editor's engine-cli dev-dependency.

GraphView remains a separate document/transaction from the semantic Graph. No persisted schema, Stable ID, or existing public serialization contract is changed.
